name: PrimoDock
author: primo
description: Application dock for Omarchy. Tracks Hyprland windows across workspaces with smart launch, focus and cycling behavior, per-window minimize-to-dock and restore, drag & drop reordering, and a rich right-click action card featuring .desktop quick actions. Touch-friendly long-press gestures mirror every mouse interaction, a Super-held System menu handles pinning and custom icon overrides, and Chromium webapps launch reliably alongside seamless Omarchy theme integration.
